metadata.question: Does vegetation cover increase in the Taklamakan Desert near Hotan from February 23, 2020 to April 29, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Taklamakan Desert near Hotan (approximately 37.1°N, 79.9°E in Xinjiang, China) - Dates: February 23, 2020 and April 29, 2020 - Collection: MODIS vegetation indices (MOD13Q1) or surface reflectance for NDVI calculation - MOD13Q1 is 16-day composite, so I'll use the closest available images to these dates 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality bands to mask poor quality pixels - For MOD13Q1, use the reliability band to filter valid NDVI values 3. Logic: - Compare NDVI between the two dates - Valid Zero: NDVI can legitimately be near 0 in desert (sparse vegetation) - C1: No images in collection - C2: All pixels masked out - C3: Result is None/NaN or out of valid NDVI range (-1 to 1) - A: NDVI increases from Feb to Apr - B: NDVI does not increase ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions hotan = ee.Geometry.Point([79.9, 37.1]) roi = hotan.buffer(10000) # 10km buffer around Hotan date1_start = '2020-02-15' date1_end = '2020-03-05' date2_start = '2020-04-20' date2_end = '2020-05-10' # 2. Data Acquisition collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') \ .filterBounds(roi) # Get images for both periods col1 = collection.filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) col2 = collection.filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) size1 = col1.size().getInfo() size2 = col2.size().getInfo() print(f"Period 1 (Feb 23, 2020): {size1} images") print(f"Period 2 (Apr 29, 2020): {size2} images") if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0: print("Missing data for one or both periods.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Get median NDVI for each period img1 = col1.median().select('NDVI') img2 = col2.median().select('NDVI') # Scale NDVI (MODIS NDVI scale factor is 0.0001) img1 = img1.multiply(0.0001) img2 = img2.multiply(0.0001) # 4. Calculate statistics stats1 = img1.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=roi, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9 ) stats2 = img2.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=roi, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9 ) ndvi1_mean = stats1.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo() ndvi1_count = stats1.get('NDVI_count').getInfo() ndvi2_mean = stats2.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo() ndvi2_count = stats2.get('NDVI_count').getInfo() print(f"Feb 2020 - NDVI mean: {ndvi1_mean}, Valid pixels: {ndvi1_count}") print(f"Apr 2020 - NDVI mean: {ndvi2_mean}, Valid pixels: {ndvi2_count}") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if ndvi1_count == 0 or ndvi2_count == 0: print("No valid pixels after processing.") print("C2") elif ndvi1_mean is None or ndvi2_mean is None: print("Calculation failed - invalid result.") print("C3") elif ndvi1_mean < -1 or ndvi1_mean > 1 or ndvi2_mean < -1 or ndvi2_mean > 1: print("NDVI values out of valid range.") print("C3") else: change = ndvi2_mean - ndvi1_mean print(f"NDVI change: {change:.4f}") if ndvi2_mean > ndvi1_mean: print("Vegetation cover increased.") print("A") else: print("Vegetation cover did not increase.") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
hotan = ee.Geometry.Point([79.9, 37.1])
roi = hotan.buffer(10000)  # 10km buffer around Hotan

date1_start = '2020-02-15'
date1_end = '2020-03-05'
date2_start = '2020-04-20'
date2_end = '2020-05-10'

# 2. Data Acquisition
collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') \
    .filterBounds(roi)

# Get images for both periods
col1 = collection.filterDate(date1_start, date1_end)
col2 = collection.filterDate(date2_start, date2_end)

size1 = col1.size().getInfo()
size2 = col2.size().getInfo()

print(f"Period 1 (Feb 23, 2020): {size1} images")
print(f"Period 2 (Apr 29, 2020): {size2} images")

if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0:
    print("Missing data for one or both periods.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Get median NDVI for each period
    img1 = col1.median().select('NDVI')
    img2 = col2.median().select('NDVI')
    
    # Scale NDVI (MODIS NDVI scale factor is 0.0001)
    img1 = img1.multiply(0.0001)
    img2 = img2.multiply(0.0001)
    
    # 4. Calculate statistics
    stats1 = img1.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=roi,
        scale=250,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    stats2 = img2.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=roi,
        scale=250,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    ndvi1_mean = stats1.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo()
    ndvi1_count = stats1.get('NDVI_count').getInfo()
    ndvi2_mean = stats2.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo()
    ndvi2_count = stats2.get('NDVI_count').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Feb 2020 - NDVI mean: {ndvi1_mean}, Valid pixels: {ndvi1_count}")
    print(f"Apr 2020 - NDVI mean: {ndvi2_mean}, Valid pixels: {ndvi2_count}")
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if ndvi1_count == 0 or ndvi2_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif ndvi1_mean is None or ndvi2_mean is None:
        print("Calculation failed - invalid result.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif ndvi1_mean < -1 or ndvi1_mean > 1 or ndvi2_mean < -1 or ndvi2_mean > 1:
        print("NDVI values out of valid range.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        change = ndvi2_mean - ndvi1_mean
        print(f"NDVI change: {change:.4f}")
        
        if ndvi2_mean > ndvi1_mean:
            print("Vegetation cover increased.")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("Vegetation cover did not increase.")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
